name: Emit Autolab
tagline: Car-leasing app for Uzbekistan: MyID check, car catalog, contracts and card payments
role: iOS and Android app development by the Softwhere team

scenes.title: Welcome, then phone sign-up
scenes.body: A branded welcome screen, then sign-up by phone number with privacy and personal-data consent checkboxes.

scenes.title: From catalog to a monthly price
scenes.body: Brand rows open a car page with a colour picker, region and dealer choice, and the full installment breakdown.

scenes.title: Identity check with MyID
scenes.body: Passport and birth date, then a MyID face check through native iOS and Android modules ahead of scoring.

scenes.title: Contracts that show every stage
scenes.body: Status badges follow scoring, car and insurance payments; each contract lists its costs and is signed in-app.

scenes.title: Pay by card, keep the receipt
scenes.body: Uzcard or Humo cards pay scoring and contract fees: confirm in a sheet, approve by code, get a fiscal receipt.
